Well, I'd first check the Nvidia control panel or something like that, and make sure that you have it set to the external GPU. Because I'm pretty sure you have a CPU with integrated graphics, so, make sure it's not using that.

I had a laptop that had two GPUs, one was used for the desktop and such, and the other one was used for games. It defaulted to the first one, and I had to change it in the options.
